column1: # Taiwan usage applied to OpenCC s2tw output for packs/en-zh-Hant (see tools/build_packs.py).
# Columns: s2tw output, Taiwan usage. Longest match wins; one pass, so replacements are not re-matched.
# Only terms that mean the same everywhere: 程序、支持、文件、信息、数据、质量 stay as they are,
# since replacing them depends on context (design doc 3.2).
# Review: not yet reviewed by a Taiwanese speaker.
